Ab Rule 7 ki government instructions ke baaki notes. Note 6 one-way outward ya return journey reimbursement ke specified cases ka zikr karta hai. Exact conditions original order se verify karein.
Note 7: India-based officers aur staff, Indian Missions ya Posts abroad se home leave ya home leave-cum-transfer par India aate hain, to specified conditions par LTC le sakte hain.
Note 8 mein hometown aur All India LTC ko transfer ya tour journey ke saath combine karne ki baat hai. Dono ke alag orders aur reimbursement conditions check karein.
Note 9 training headquarters se related hai. Training aur Supplementary Rule 59 ke under headquarters change ki applicable treatment, LTC claim se pehle competent office se verify karein.
Notes 10 aur 11 mein PSU deputationists ki LTC options aur top-level deputation ke terms ka zikr hai. PSU scheme aur foreign service orders ki exact conditions check karein.
Note 12: Nepal mein specified Indian Aid Mission staff ki Indian LTC journey ke commencement aur end ka reference, posting ke nearest Indian railway station se linked hai.
Note 13: fresh recruits ke pehle do chaar saal ke blocks mein teen hometown occasions aur chauthe par any place ka special cycle hai. Joining date aur FAQ conditions check karein.
Note 14 mein specified regions mein family ko peeche chhodne wale employees ke LTC options aur emergency passage ka zikr hai. Eligibility aur applicable original orders verify karein.

Note 15: dono spouses Government servants hon, to specified conditions par separate claims ka option hai. Ek spouse doosre ke family member ke roop mein claim karke self ke liye dobara claim nahi karega.
Note 16 mein single disabled Government servant ke escort ke liye conditional facility hai. Note 17: suspension mein employee khud LTC nahi le sakta; eligible family le sakti hai.
